title: Better Strategy: Carbon Sequestration by Forests Logging

limitations: Table 1 shifts the growth rate, the maximum store, and the felled store off their symbols. P has no definition on its row.
Equation 6 writes one year symbol on both sides. Equation 12 puts this year stock inside its own update. Equation 14 is two lines under one number. Equation 16 prints an extra factor.
Table 2 leaves four parameter cells blank. Table 4 puts two planting costs on one row. Table 5 prints a demand with no power of ten.
No page image was opened. Zero lone surrogates. The sheet year prints 2022.

tasks: Predict forest and product carbon under a logistic cut
Choose a management plan that balances demand, profit, and carbon
Find when a forest should not be cut, and where a plan changes
Apply the plan to Tien Shan for 100 years, including a ten-year longer interval
Explain the plan in a newspaper

section_map.summary: A better strategy, a cut at half the growth rate, Beijing at 3.2 million cubic meters and 2063, and Tien Shan at 1.52 times 10 to the 8 dollars.
Neutrality as a signed offset, then products that outlive the trees.
One forest unit and one national timber price.
A printed logistic rate, a half-intensity rule, and a system sum.
Three objectives, a recurrence that uses this year stock, and a plan refused for four forest uses.
Annual felling, carbon at 11 times 10 to the 7 tons, and a profit band of 1.5 to 1.55 times 10 to the 8 dollars.
Perfect stability claimed, then beta varied under a discount-rate caption.
A 1.5 degree report, a repeated harvesting paragraph, and two limits compared with themselves.

contributions.summary: Undisturbed forest carbon is given a logistic rate, r times stock times 1 minus stock over the maximum.
The optimal intensity is the inherent growth rate over 2, because the rate peaks at half the maximum stock.
Demand, profit, and carbon are three simultaneous objectives, with products split into fuel-like and furniture-like.
Tien Shan is cut every year, and a ten-year interval is reached by stepping through two-year and four-year cuts.

dependency_graph.handoff: The forest-plus-product stock and the half-intensity rule are what the three-objective search treats as the carbon side of the plan.

assumptions.summary: The forest is one unit, so latitude and altitude do not change growth inside it.
Timber profit is one price inside a country, and special products are excluded.
Undisturbed carbon follows a logistic law and levels off at maturity.
With no social demand, all cut wood becomes long-lived products and use depreciation is ignored.
A stock below an unnamed lower limit, a reserve, an endangered stand, or a minority home is not cut.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Beijing in 2008 held 7.11 Mt, mature density is 50 megagrams per hectare, and the area ceiling is 800000 hectares.
The shared case uses 50 times 10 to the 4 hectares, demands of 160 and 400 times 10 to the 4 cubic meters, and profits of 675 and 450 dollars per cubic meter.
Subtropical, temperate, and sub-frigid densities are 80, 50, and 60, with rates 0.4, 0.4, and 0.5.
Timber uses rate 0.3 and density 50. Charcoal uses rate 0.9 and density 40. Two planting costs share a row.
Tien Shan uses 52.84 times 10 to the 4 hectares, rate 0.385, density 112.53, and an initial stock of 53.14 Mt.

models.summary: A printed logistic rate, a proportional cut, a half-intensity rule, a year update, a product accumulation, and a system sum.
A demand gap, a profit line, an ecology line, a self-referring recurrence, a product split, an intensity cap, a planting cost, and a volume conversion.

verification.summary: Cancelling the stock in the equilibrium line leaves an intensity of r times 1 minus x over N, which is below r. The paper prints that inequality.
Three zones with one shared area settle at one shared volume, 5 times 10 to the 6 cubic meters, and the paper notes the shared area.
5.2 times 10 to the 6 is above the stated demand of 4.13 times 10 to the 6, so the surplus is in the printed direction.
After beta moves, the cut is said to return to a level that still meets 4.13 times 10 to the 6 cubic meters.

results_trace.summary: Beijing stabilizes at 3.2 times 10 to the 6 cubic meters and reaches neutrality around 2063.
The same cut is 2 Mt. No intervention never balances. Moderate policy waits past the 22nd century. Strong policy is the 2063 case.
Three temperature zones settle at 5 times 10 to the 6 cubic meters. Subtropical points sit near year 8 and year 23.
Charcoal stays at 4.2 times 10 to the 6 with no transition. Timber rises from 3 times 10 to the 6 to 5 times 10 to the 6.
Tien Shan carbon settles at 11 times 10 to the 7 tons. Profit is a band of 1.5 to 1.55 times 10 to the 8 dollars. The cut settles at 5.2 times 10 to the 6.
The article asks for a 45 percent cut by 2030 and neutrality by 2050, and does not print the Tien Shan figures.

Offer the plan to every forest use, then withhold it from four.
Balance Tien Shan, and print a profit band beside a single summary profit.
Repeat the harvesting paragraph, and compare each limit with itself.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge rewards a logistic rate written as r times stock times 1 minus stock over the maximum, because the product is on the page.
A judge rewards three objectives kept on separate lines, because demand, profit, and carbon are not collapsed into one score.
A judge penalizes an equilibrium that sets a sequestration rate equal to a carbon stock.
A judge penalizes a recurrence that puts this year stock inside the term that is supposed to update it.
A judge penalizes a model offered to every forest use and then withheld from four of the five.
A judge penalizes an article that compares each logging limit with itself.

weaknesses.summary: Products are high-lived, and the summary profit of 1.52 times 10 to the 8 is not the body band.
Assumptions are stated and making statements. The horizon is after 100.
The notation table shifts three definitions. Sequestration rises by seed loading.
Equation 3 equates a rate to a stock. Equation 6 writes one symbol twice. The optimum is r over 2.
2 Mt is called 3.2 million cubic meters. No factor is printed.
Equation 12 uses this year stock inside the rate. Equation 16 prints wp. Equation 18 writes V for v.
The plan is a plus care, and it is refused for protection, economic, and special-purpose forests.
Two planting costs share one row. Timber and charcoal transition stories do not share a point.
The demand 413.86 has no power of ten. The caption says anf ecconomic.
The body profit is 1.5 to 1.55 times 10 to the 8, not the summary 1.52 times 10 to the 8.
Perfect stability is claimed, then beta is varied under a discount-rate caption.
One paragraph is printed twice, and each limit is compared with itself. Neutrality in the article is 2050.
The leaf-area citation is a garden-tree paper. The policy figure is a CMIP6 scenario paper.

independent_extensions.statement: Place the equilibrium line that sets the sequestration rate equal to E times x against the printed condition E less than r, and say whether cancelling x is enough to turn a rate into an intensity.
independent_extensions.reason: The inequality can follow from the logistic factor. The equality of a rate and a stock cannot.

independent_extensions.statement: Place the summary profit 1.52 times 10 to the 8 dollars against the body band 1.5 to 1.55 times 10 to the 8 dollars, and say whether one Tien Shan plan can carry both.
independent_extensions.reason: The summary names a point. The body names a range.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Supports a logistic carbon stock, a cut set at half the inherent growth rate, and a yearly update over a horizon to 2063.
Supports a demand-profit-carbon decision, a genetic search over two product volumes, and a plan that changes when the interval is lengthened by ten years.

unresolved_questions: What factor turns 2 Mt of cut carbon into 3.2 million cubic meters.
Which symbol in Table 1 is the inherent growth rate once the shift is removed.
What values belong in the four blank cells of Table 2.
Whether 413.86 cubic meters of Tien Shan demand is missing a power of ten.
Whether the summary profit 1.52 times 10 to the 8 is the midpoint of the body band or a different run.
